title: Rank reduction autoencoders for mechanical design: Learning structured latent manifolds for topology optimization
authors: Ismael Ben-Yelun, Mohammed El Fallaki Idrissi, Jad Mounayer, Sebastian Rodriguez, Francisco Chinesta
abstract: This work presents a data-driven framework for fast forward and inverse analyses in topology optimization by combining Rank Reduction Autoencoders with neural latent-space mappings. The methodology targets the efficient approximation of the relationship between optimized geometries and their corresponding mechanical responses or quantities of interest with a particular focus on compliance-minimized linear elastic structures. High-dimensional topology optimization results are first compressed using Rank Reduction Autoencoders, which encode the data into low-dimensional manifolds via Singular Value Decomposition, thus extracting the most important (latent) features. Separate Rank Reduction Autoencoder models are trained for geometry and for different types of quantities of interest, including scalar metrics, one-dimensional stress fields, and full two-dimensional von Mises stress distributions. The resulting low-dimensional latent manifolds are then related through multilayer perceptrons to address both direct problems – predicting structural responses from geometry – and inverse problems—recovering geometries from prescribed performance targets. The proposed approach is demonstrated on a half MBB beam and a cantilever beam, with the latter studied under separate and simultaneous variations in volume fraction and load position, using datasets generated via density-based Solid Isotropic Material with Penalization optimization. Numerical results show that the framework enables accurate and computationally efficient surrogate models, with increasing robustness and fidelity as richer quantities of interest are considered. The methodology also shows potential for generative mechanical design through preliminary examples of new geometries and response synthesis via latent-space exploration.

infographic.key_insight: Rank Reduction Autoencoders connect compressed geometry and mechanical-response representations to enable fast forward prediction and inverse topology design.
infographic.engineering_relevance: The framework offers efficient surrogate models for exploring compliance-minimized structures and recovering candidate geometries from prescribed performance targets.
method: Generate optimized structures using density-based SIMP topology optimization.
Train separate SVD-based Rank Reduction Autoencoders for geometries and scalar or field-valued mechanical responses.

infographic.evidence_signal: Tests on a half MBB beam and a cantilever beam with varying volume fraction and load position showed improved robustness and fidelity with richer response information, though the abstract reports no numerical error or speedup values.
infographic.watch_item: Generalization beyond the studied linear-elastic benchmarks and physical validation of newly generated designs remain to be established.

zh-Hans.title: 面向机械设计的降秩自编码器：学习用于拓扑优化的结构化潜在流形
zh-Hans.abstract: 本研究将降秩自编码器与神经网络潜在空间映射相结合，提出了一种用于拓扑优化中快速正向与逆向分析的数据驱动框架。该方法旨在高效近似优化后的几何形状与其相应力学响应或关注量之间的关系，重点关注柔度最小化的线弹性结构。首先，使用降秩自编码器压缩高维拓扑优化结果，通过奇异值分解将数据编码到低维流形中，从而提取最重要的（潜在）特征。针对几何形状和不同类型的关注量，分别训练独立的降秩自编码器模型；这些关注量包括标量指标、一维应力场以及完整的二维 von Mises 应力分布。随后，通过多层感知机建立所得低维潜在流形之间的联系，以同时解决正向问题——根据几何形状预测结构响应，以及逆向问题——根据给定的性能目标反求几何形状。所提出的方法在半 MBB 梁和悬臂梁上进行了演示，其中针对悬臂梁研究了体积分数与载荷位置分别变化和同时变化的情况，所用数据集通过基于密度的固体各向同性材料惩罚（Solid Isotropic Material with Penalization）优化生成。数值结果表明，该框架能够构建准确且计算高效的代理模型，并且随着所考虑的关注量信息更加丰富，其鲁棒性与保真度也随之提高。通过潜在空间探索生成新几何形状和合成响应的初步示例，该方法还展示了其在生成式机械设计中的潜力。

infographic.key_insight: 降秩自编码器将压缩后的几何形状表示与力学响应表示联系起来，实现快速正向预测与逆向拓扑设计。
infographic.engineering_relevance: 该框架提供了高效的代理模型，可用于探索柔度最小化结构，并根据给定的性能目标反求候选几何形状。
method: 使用基于密度的 SIMP 拓扑优化生成优化结构。
针对几何形状以及标量或场形式的力学响应，分别训练基于 SVD 的降秩自编码器。
通过多层感知机连接潜在空间，进行正向与逆向分析。
infographic.evidence_signal: 在体积分数与载荷位置变化条件下对半 MBB 梁和悬臂梁进行的测试表明，更丰富的响应信息提高了鲁棒性与保真度，但摘要未报告数值误差或加速比。
infographic.watch_item: 该方法在所研究的线弹性基准算例之外的泛化能力，以及新生成设计的物理验证，仍有待确立。

title: Effect of Laser Remelting on the Microstructure, Mechanical and Tribological Properties of Detonation-Sprayed NiCrFeBSiC Coatings for Mechanical Engineering Applications
authors: Dastan Buitkenov, Nurmakhanbet Raisov, Laila Sulyubayeva, A.Y. Zhakupova, Daryn Baizhan, Nurbol Berdimuratov
abstract: This study investigates the effect of laser remelting on the microstructure, phase composition, mechanical properties, tribological behavior, and corrosion resistance of self-fluxing NiCrFeBSiC coatings deposited onto AISI 321 stainless steel by detonation spraying. The coatings were characterized before and after laser treatment using scanning electron microscopy (SEM), energy-dispersive X-ray spectroscopy (EDS), X-ray diffraction (XRD), instrumented indentation, adhesion testing, ball-on-disk tribometry, and potentiodynamic polarization measurements. SEM analysis revealed that laser remelting reduced coating porosity from 0.306 ± 0.014% to 0.15 ± 0.09%, accompanied by microstructural densification and a reduction in coating thickness. XRD analysis confirmed the preservation of the principal crystalline phases, including Ni3Fe, Cr7C3, CrB, and Ni3B, following laser treatment. The Vickers hardness increased from 1049.1 ± 43.4 to 1206.1 ± 63.1 HV, while the elastic modulus increased from 233.6 ± 6.2 to 258.4 ± 5.3 GPa. Furthermore, adhesion strength increased by 19.4%, whereas surface roughness decreased by 19.2%. Laser remelting significantly improved tribological performance, reducing the average coefficient of friction from 0.535 ± 0.048 to 0.409 ± 0.086 and the specific wear rate from 2.864 × 10−4 to 1.447 × 10−4 mm3/(N·m), corresponding to a 49.5% reduction in wear. Electrochemical measurements indicated a modest decrease in corrosion current density of approximately 3.0%, accompanied by changes in the morphology of corrosion-affected regions. The improvements are associated with laser-induced microstructural densification, redistribution of alloying elements, and preservation of hard reinforcing phases. These findings demonstrate the potential of combining detonation spraying with laser remelting to produce wear-resistant nickel-based protective coatings for mechanical and power engineering applications.
venue: Journal of Manufacturing and Materials Processing

infographic.key_insight: Laser remelting densified detonation-sprayed NiCrFeBSiC coatings, increasing hardness and adhesion while reducing specific wear rate by 49.5%.
infographic.engineering_relevance: The combined process could improve wear-resistant nickel-based protective coatings on AISI 321 stainless steel for mechanical and power engineering components.

infographic.watch_item: Remelting reduced coating thickness, while corrosion current density improved by only approximately 3%; application-specific thickness and corrosion requirements need validation.
infographic.paper_title: Effect of Laser Remelting on the Microstructure, Mechanical and Tribological Properties of Detonation-Sprayed NiCrFeBSiC Coatings for Mechanical Engineering Applications

zh-Hans.title: 激光重熔对机械工程应用中爆炸喷涂NiCrFeBSiC涂层微观组织、力学性能和摩擦学性能的影响
zh-Hans.abstract: 本研究考察了激光重熔对采用爆炸喷涂在AISI 321不锈钢基体上制备的自熔性NiCrFeBSiC涂层的微观组织、物相组成、力学性能、摩擦学行为和耐腐蚀性的影响。采用扫描电子显微镜（SEM）、能量色散X射线能谱（EDS）、X射线衍射（XRD）、仪器化压入测试、结合强度测试、球盘式摩擦磨损测试和动电位极化测量，对激光处理前后的涂层进行表征。SEM分析表明，激光重熔使涂层孔隙率从0.306 ± 0.014%降至0.15 ± 0.09%，同时伴随微观组织致密化和涂层厚度减小。XRD分析证实，激光处理后，Ni3Fe、Cr7C3、CrB和Ni3B等主要晶相得以保留。维氏硬度从1049.1 ± 43.4 HV提高至1206.1 ± 63.1 HV，弹性模量从233.6 ± 6.2 GPa提高至258.4 ± 5.3 GPa。此外，结合强度提高了19.4%，表面粗糙度降低了19.2%。激光重熔显著改善了摩擦学性能，使平均摩擦系数从0.535 ± 0.048降至0.409 ± 0.086，比磨损率从2.864 × 10−4降至1.447 × 10−4 mm3/(N·m)，对应磨损降低49.5%。电化学测量表明，腐蚀电流密度小幅降低约3.0%，同时腐蚀影响区域的形貌发生变化。这些性能改善与激光诱导的微观组织致密化、合金元素再分布以及硬质增强相的保留有关。这些发现表明，将爆炸喷涂与激光重熔相结合，有望制备用于机械和动力工程领域的耐磨镍基防护涂层。

infographic.key_insight: 激光重熔使爆炸喷涂NiCrFeBSiC涂层致密化，提高了硬度和结合强度，同时使比磨损率降低了49.5%。
infographic.engineering_relevance: 该组合工艺有望改善机械和动力工程部件中AISI 321不锈钢表面的耐磨镍基防护涂层。
method: 采用爆炸喷涂沉积NiCrFeBSiC涂层，然后进行激光重熔。
利用SEM、EDS和XRD比较微观组织和物相。
评估硬度、模量、结合强度、摩擦、磨损和电化学腐蚀行为。
infographic.evidence_signal: 重熔后，硬度从1049.1 HV升至1206.1 HV，平均摩擦系数从0.535降至0.409，比磨损率从2.864 × 10⁻⁴降至1.447 × 10⁻⁴ mm³/(N·m)。
infographic.watch_item: 重熔使涂层厚度减小，而腐蚀电流密度仅降低约3%；仍需验证涂层是否满足具体应用的厚度和耐腐蚀要求。

title: Image segmentation in friction stir welding using convolutional neural networks
authors: Fabian Vieltorf, Côme Calluaud, Moritz Goeldner, Martina Elisabeth Sigl, Michael F. Zaeh
abstract: Abstract Friction stir welding is an advanced joining process widely used for its superior weld quality, high seam strength, and minimal distortion. Therefore, it is widely applied in industries that require these characteristics, such as the aerospace and the automotive sector (battery trays for electric vehicles). Nevertheless, process irregularities may occur, leading to defects that are often visible on the weld seam surface. For this reason, the weld seam surface is typically inspected after welding by means of human visual inspection. This requires well-trained personnel and involves challenges such as detailed documentation and time-consuming evaluation, particularly when multiple or long weld seams are examined. To address the limitations of post-process inspection, inline quality monitoring systems are gaining increasing importance. Several studies have investigated surface quality monitoring approaches, often in combination with image classification models. The present work contributes to automated surface quality monitoring by investigating the use of modern convolutional neural networks in a pixel-level approach (semantic segmentation). Segmentation enables the identification, localization, and quantification of surface defects. In this study, promising results were obtained for the segmentation of flash, surface galling, and surface lack of fill, with a global accuracy of 97.69% and a mean intersection over union (mIoU) of 83.78%. An IoU of 79.18% was achieved for flash, while the IoUs for surface lack of fill and surface galling were 80.22% and 66.87%, respectively. Future studies will compare automated visual inspection with process monitoring approaches based on process responses, such as process forces and process temperatures.

infographic.key_insight: Convolutional neural networks segmented friction stir weld surface defects at pixel level, achieving 97.69% global accuracy and 83.78% mean intersection over union (mIoU).
infographic.engineering_relevance: Automated defect identification, localization, and quantification could support inline weld inspection and reduce reliance on time-consuming human visual assessment.
method: Apply CNN-based semantic segmentation to weld surface images.
Identify flash, surface galling, and surface lack of fill.
Evaluate pixel-level performance using global accuracy and IoU.
infographic.evidence_signal: Reported defect IoUs were 79.18% for flash, 80.22% for surface lack of fill, and 66.87% for surface galling.
infographic.watch_item: Surface galling had the lowest reported defect IoU; the abstract does not establish robustness across production conditions or real-time deployment.
infographic.paper_title: Image segmentation in friction stir welding using convolutional neural networks

zh-Hans.title: 基于卷积神经网络的搅拌摩擦焊图像分割
zh-Hans.abstract: 摘要 搅拌摩擦焊是一种先进的连接工艺，因其优异的焊接质量、高焊缝强度和极小的变形而得到广泛应用。因此，该工艺广泛应用于需要这些特性的行业，例如航空航天和汽车行业（电动汽车电池托盘）。然而，焊接过程中仍可能出现异常，导致焊缝表面出现通常可见的缺陷。因此，焊接后通常采用人工目视检查的方式检查焊缝表面。这需要训练有素的人员，并面临详细记录和评估耗时等挑战，尤其是在检查多条或较长焊缝时。为克服焊后检查的局限性，在线质量监测系统正变得日益重要。已有多项研究探讨了表面质量监测方法，且通常结合图像分类模型。本研究通过探讨现代卷积神经网络在像素级方法（语义分割）中的应用，推动表面质量自动化监测的发展。分割能够实现表面缺陷的识别、定位和量化。本研究在飞边、表面拉伤和表面填充不足的分割方面取得了有前景的结果，总体准确率为97.69%，平均交并比（mIoU）为83.78%。飞边的交并比（IoU）达到79.18%，表面填充不足和表面拉伤的IoU分别为80.22%和66.87%。未来研究将比较自动化视觉检查与基于过程响应（如过程力和过程温度）的过程监测方法。

infographic.key_insight: 卷积神经网络实现了搅拌摩擦焊焊缝表面缺陷的像素级分割，总体准确率达到97.69%，平均交并比（mIoU）达到83.78%。
infographic.engineering_relevance: 自动化缺陷识别、定位和量化有望支持在线焊缝检查，并减少对耗时的人工目视评估的依赖。
method: 将基于CNN的语义分割应用于焊缝表面图像。
识别飞边、表面拉伤和表面填充不足。
使用总体准确率和IoU评估像素级性能。
infographic.evidence_signal: 报告的缺陷IoU分别为：飞边79.18%、表面填充不足80.22%、表面拉伤66.87%。
infographic.watch_item: 表面拉伤的缺陷IoU在报告结果中最低；该摘要尚未证实该方法在不同生产条件下的稳健性或实时部署能力。

title: Development of a Cost-Effective Nickel-Based Welding Consumable for Cryogenic LNG Storage Applications: Mechanical Properties and Impact Toughness at −196 °C
authors: Sarkis Muradian, Mingzhou Liu, Cheng Su, Wenqiang Sun
abstract: A nickel-based weld metal with a significantly reduced tungsten content (approximately 0.5 wt.%, compared with conventional ERNiCrMo-4) was developed and evaluated for potential application in cryogenic LNG storage systems. The deposited weld metal exhibited a yield strength of 510 MPa, tensile strength of 746 MPa, and elongation of 40%, with an average Charpy impact energy of 169 J at −196 °C. The results demonstrate that high mechanical performance can be achieved with substantially reduced tungsten content, offering the potential to lower raw material costs by approximately 10–20%.
venue: International Journal of Modern Developments in Engineering and Science

infographic.key_insight: A nickel-based weld metal with approximately 0.5 wt.% tungsten achieved high strength and impact toughness at −196 °C, with potential raw material cost savings of 10–20%.
infographic.engineering_relevance: The consumable could offer a lower-cost welding option for cryogenic LNG storage systems without sacrificing the reported mechanical performance.

infographic.watch_item: The abstract does not establish full-joint qualification or verified production cost savings; both require validation before LNG service adoption.

zh-Hans.title: 用于低温 LNG 储存的高性价比镍基焊接材料开发：−196 °C 下的力学性能与冲击韧性
zh-Hans.abstract: 开发了一种钨含量显著降低（约 0.5 wt.%，低于常规 ERNiCrMo-4）的镍基焊缝金属，并评估了其在低温 LNG 储存系统中的潜在应用。熔敷金属的屈服强度为 510 MPa，抗拉强度为 746 MPa，伸长率为 40%，在 −196 °C 下的平均夏比冲击吸收能量为 169 J。结果表明，在大幅降低钨含量的情况下仍可获得优异的力学性能，有望将原材料成本降低约 10–20%。

title: Computational and machine learning modelling approaches for weld quality predictions in friction stir welding of high-density polyethylene
authors: A. Alhourani, I. Barsoum, J. Sheikh-Ahmad, S. Deveci
abstract: Friction stir welding (FSW) has gained recognition as an effective technique for joining thermoplastic materials. This study presents a comprehensive investigation to predict FSW characteristics such as weld temperatures, vertical axial forces, material flow and defect formation in FSW of high-density polyethylene (HDPE) using both computational and machine learning approaches, validated by experimental results. A three-dimensional Coupled Eulerian-Lagrangian (CEL) numerical model is developed to simulate the HDPE welding process under varying process parameters of rotational and welding speeds, and bottom preheating conditions. The CEL numerical model is validated against experimental data, showing markedly good agreement in predicting void formation, thermal and mechanical responses. Results indicate that preheating the bottom surface proved effective in reducing thermal gradients and stabilizing vertical force fluctuations. Quantitatively, bottom-surface preheating at 60 °C reduced peak plunge force from 1600 N close to 1100 N and raised peak temperatures from 70 °C (without preheat) to about 100 °C, hence smoothing through-thickness gradients and stabilizing the axial force distribution. In parallel, two multilayer perceptron artificial neural networks (ANNs) are trained on experimental data to predict temporal temperature and axial force responses with R2 between 0.91 and 0.99, demonstrating high accuracy and strong generalization across the tested FSW parameter space. The computational CEL simulations accurately predicted weld zone morphology, including stir zone, thermo-mechanically affected zone and heat-affected zone, however the combined CEL–ANN framework enables rapid generation of process maps that highlights defective and defect-free welding windows, with optimal conditions obtained at 1500 rpm and 30 mm/min with 60 °C preheating, and poor weldability observed at 1000 rpm without preheating due to wormhole formation. These findings provide process-driven design guidelines for developing robust HDPE joints and demonstrate how integrating computational modeling with machine learning enables efficient optimization, offering valuable insights into the key characteristics of the FSW process in thermoplastics and supporting its broader adoption in industrial applications.

infographic.key_insight: Combining physics-based simulation and neural networks mapped HDPE friction stir welding quality, identifying 1500 rpm, 30 mm/min and 60 °C bottom preheating as optimal within the tested conditions.
infographic.engineering_relevance: Bottom preheating can reduce welding loads and thermal gradients, supporting more stable processing and defect-free HDPE joints.
method: Developed a 3D Coupled Eulerian–Lagrangian model of temperature, force, material flow and defect formation.
Trained two multilayer perceptron neural networks on experimental temperature and axial-force data.
Combined simulation and ANN predictions to map defective and defect-free welding windows.
infographic.evidence_signal: Experimental validation showed good agreement with simulations; ANN predictions achieved R² of 0.91–0.99, while 60 °C preheating reduced peak plunge force from 1600 N to about 1100 N.
infographic.watch_item: Predictive performance outside the tested welding parameters and material conditions requires further validation.

zh-Hans.title: 用于预测高密度聚乙烯搅拌摩擦焊焊接质量的计算建模与机器学习建模方法
zh-Hans.abstract: 搅拌摩擦焊（FSW）已被认可为连接热塑性材料的一种有效技术。本研究综合采用计算方法和机器学习方法，对高密度聚乙烯（HDPE）搅拌摩擦焊中的焊接温度、竖直轴向力、材料流动及缺陷形成等特征进行预测，并通过实验结果加以验证。研究建立了三维耦合欧拉–拉格朗日（CEL）数值模型，以模拟不同转速、焊接速度和底部预热条件下的HDPE焊接过程。通过实验数据验证了CEL数值模型，结果表明，该模型在预测孔洞形成、热响应和力学响应方面与实验高度吻合。结果显示，底面预热可有效减小温度梯度，并抑制竖直力波动。定量而言，60 °C底面预热使峰值下压力由1600 N降至接近1100 N，并使峰值温度由未预热时的70 °C升至约100 °C，从而减缓厚度方向的温度梯度，并使轴向力分布更加稳定。同时，利用实验数据训练了两个多层感知机人工神经网络（ANN），用于预测温度和轴向力随时间变化的响应，R2介于0.91至0.99之间，表明其在所测试的FSW参数空间内具有较高的精度和较强的泛化能力。CEL计算模拟准确预测了焊接区域的形貌，包括搅拌区、热机影响区和热影响区；而CEL–ANN组合框架则能够快速生成工艺图谱，标示出存在缺陷和无缺陷的焊接工艺窗口。在所测试条件下，1500 rpm、30 mm/min及60 °C预热为最优条件；在1000 rpm且无预热的条件下，则因形成虫洞缺陷而表现出较差的可焊性。这些发现为制备性能可靠的HDPE接头提供了基于工艺的设计指导，并展示了计算建模与机器学习的集成如何实现高效优化，为理解热塑性材料FSW工艺的关键特征提供了有价值的见解，同时支持该工艺在工业应用中的更广泛采用。

title: Non-Destructive Evaluation for Engineered Surfaces: Methods, In-Process Sensing, and Data-Driven Inspection in the NDE 4.0 Era
authors: Kuldeep Sharma, R. P. Sharma
abstract: Engineered surfaces such as coatings, diffusion layers, cold-sprayed deposits, laser-clad overlays, additively manufactured surface regions, peened layers, and anodised films increasingly determine the performance, inspect ability, and service life of high-value metallic and ceramic components. Wear, corrosion, fatigue, oxidation, debonding, and crack initiation are controlled in these shallow, graded, anisotropic, and interface- dominated regions. This review examines how non-destructive evaluation (NDE) methods can be selected and qualified for them. It links inspection physics to specific problems: coating thickness and adhesion, near- surface residual stress, porosity gradients, lack of fusion, thermal-barrier-coating debonding, weak cold-spray interfaces, and additive-manufacturing surface roughness. Magnetic Barkhausen noise, eddy-current testing, active infrared thermography, phased-array and laser ultrasonics, acoustic emission, optical metrology, digital image correlation, microwave and terahertz sensing, and X-ray computed tomography are assessed for both capability and limitation. The review argues for hierarchical, multi-modal strategies in which rapid screening is followed by calibrated confirmation where required. It also covers the shift toward NDE 4.0, including in- process sensing, data fusion, physics-informed machine learning, uncertainty-aware interpretation, and digital twins. Persistent barriers include limited probability-of-detection evidence, poor transferability of data-driven models, scarce reference specimens, and incomplete acceptance criteria
venue: South Mediterranean University Journal of Pure and Applied Sciences

infographic.engineering_relevance: Targeted inspection can support quality and service-life assessment of coatings, cold-sprayed deposits, laser-clad overlays, and additively manufactured surface regions.

zh-Hans.title: 工程化表面的无损评价：NDE 4.0时代的方法、过程传感与数据驱动检测
zh-Hans.abstract: 涂层、扩散层、冷喷涂沉积层、激光熔覆层、增材制造表面区域、喷丸层和阳极氧化膜等工程化表面，日益决定着高价值金属与陶瓷构件的性能、可检测性和使用寿命。磨损、腐蚀、疲劳、氧化、脱粘和裂纹萌生均受这些浅薄、梯度变化、各向异性且由界面主导的区域控制。本综述探讨如何针对这些区域选择无损评价（NDE）方法并验证其适用性。文章将检测物理原理与具体问题相联系，包括涂层厚度与附着力、近表面残余应力、孔隙率梯度、未熔合、热障涂层脱粘、冷喷涂界面结合薄弱以及增材制造表面粗糙度。文章评估了磁巴克豪森噪声、涡流检测、主动红外热成像、相控阵超声与激光超声、声发射、光学计量、数字图像相关、微波与太赫兹传感以及X射线计算机断层成像的能力与局限性。本综述主张采用分层、多模态策略，即先进行快速筛查，再在必要时通过经校准的检测加以确认。文章还讨论了向NDE 4.0的转型，包括过程传感、数据融合、物理信息机器学习、考虑不确定性的结果解读以及数字孪生。持续存在的障碍包括检出概率证据有限、数据驱动模型的可迁移性不足、参考试样稀缺以及验收准则不完善。

title: Microstructure and surface performance of detonation gun sprayed 80Ni20Cr and NiCrAlY coatings on Al 6061-T6 substrate for structural applications
authors: T. Sampath kumar, Rajaram Ganesan, M.M. Reddy
abstract: Two protective coatings, 80Ni20Cr and NiCrAlY, were deposited on Al 6061-T6 alloy substrates using the Detonation Gun (D-Gun) thermal spray process. The deposited coatings were studied for their microstructure, phase composition, surface roughness, hardness, corrosion behaviour, wettability, and solid particle erosion resistance. Characterisation was done using SEM-EDS, XRD, AFM, nanoindentation, potentiodynamic polarisation, contact angle measurement, and erosion testing. SEM-EDS results showed that both coatings bonded well to the substrate with uniform thickness. The NiCrAlY coating had a denser microstructure with lower porosity compared to 80Ni20Cr. XRD identified CrNi phases with FCC crystal structure in 80Ni20Cr and Al₂NiY phases with orthorhombic structure in NiCrAlY. Nanocrystalline grain structure was observed in both coatings. AFM measurements showed that NiCrAlY had the lowest surface roughness among all three samples. Nanoindentation results showed that NiCrAlY hardness is approximately 10 times higher than 80Ni20Cr. Specifically, NiCrAlY showed a hardness of 7895.36 MPa (731.2 HV), compared with 780.11 MPa (72.25 HV) for 80Ni20Cr and 708.68 MPa for the uncoated Al 6061 substrate. Potentiodynamic polarisation tests in 3.5 wt% NaCl solution confirmed that NiCrAlY recorded the lowest corrosion current density of 6.625 × 10 -7 A/cm² and a corrosion rate of 0.00567 mmpy. The 80Ni20Cr coating gave a corrosion current density of 1.585 × 10 - 6 A/cm² and a corrosion rate of 0.01427 mmpy. Both figures are considerably lower than the bare substrate at 0.5185 mmpy. Contact angle measurements confirmed superhydrophobic behaviour for NiCrAlY and near-superhydrophobic behaviour for 80Ni20Cr. Solid particle erosion test results showed that 80Ni20Cr recorded the lowest mass loss. Under the laboratory conditions used (3.5 wt% NaCl at room temperature; a single erosion condition of 90° impact angle, 40 m/s and 5 min), NiCrAlY showed the better hardness and corrosion resistance, whereas 80Ni20Cr showed the better erosion resistance. These results indicate relative performance under the test conditions and are not a prediction of long-term service life.

infographic.engineering_relevance: Coating selection should match the dominant exposure: NiCrAlY for hardness and saline corrosion resistance, or 80Ni20Cr for erosion resistance under the tested conditions.

zh-Hans.title: 面向结构应用的Al 6061-T6基体上爆炸喷枪喷涂80Ni20Cr和NiCrAlY涂层的微观组织与表面性能
zh-Hans.abstract: 采用爆炸喷枪（D-Gun）热喷涂工艺，在Al 6061-T6合金基体上沉积了80Ni20Cr和NiCrAlY两种防护涂层。研究了所沉积涂层的微观组织、相组成、表面粗糙度、硬度、腐蚀行为、润湿性及抗固体颗粒冲蚀性能。采用SEM-EDS、XRD、AFM、纳米压痕、动电位极化、接触角测量和冲蚀试验进行表征。SEM-EDS结果表明，两种涂层均与基体结合良好，且厚度均匀。与80Ni20Cr相比，NiCrAlY涂层的微观组织更致密，孔隙率更低。XRD在80Ni20Cr中鉴定出具有面心立方（FCC）晶体结构的CrNi相，在NiCrAlY中鉴定出具有正交晶体结构的Al₂NiY相。两种涂层中均观察到纳米晶组织。AFM测量表明，在全部三个样品中，NiCrAlY的表面粗糙度最低。纳米压痕结果表明，NiCrAlY的硬度约为80Ni20Cr的10倍。具体而言，NiCrAlY的硬度为7895.36 MPa（731.2 HV），80Ni20Cr为780.11 MPa（72.25 HV），未涂覆的Al 6061基体为708.68 MPa。在3.5 wt% NaCl溶液中进行的动电位极化试验证实，NiCrAlY的腐蚀电流密度最低，为6.625 × 10⁻⁷ A/cm²，腐蚀速率为0.00567 mmpy。80Ni20Cr涂层的腐蚀电流密度为1.585 × 10⁻⁶ A/cm²，腐蚀速率为0.01427 mmpy。两种涂层的腐蚀速率均显著低于裸基体的0.5185 mmpy。接触角测量证实，NiCrAlY表现出超疏水性，80Ni20Cr则表现出接近超疏水的特性。固体颗粒冲蚀试验结果表明，80Ni20Cr的质量损失最低。在所采用的实验室条件下（室温下的3.5 wt% NaCl溶液；冲击角度为90°、速度为40 m/s、持续时间为5 min的单一冲蚀工况），NiCrAlY表现出更高的硬度和更好的耐腐蚀性，而80Ni20Cr表现出更好的抗冲蚀性能。这些结果反映了试验条件下的相对性能，并非对长期服役寿命的预测。

infographic.key_insight: 在Al 6061-T6基体上，D-Gun喷涂的NiCrAlY具有更高的硬度和更好的耐腐蚀性，而80Ni20Cr具有更好的抗冲蚀性能。
infographic.engineering_relevance: 涂层选择应与主要暴露工况相匹配：在所测试条件下，若侧重硬度和耐盐水腐蚀性，可选择NiCrAlY；若侧重抗冲蚀性能，可选择80Ni20Cr。
method: 采用爆炸喷枪热喷涂工艺，在Al 6061-T6上沉积80Ni20Cr和NiCrAlY涂层。
采用SEM-EDS、XRD、AFM和纳米压痕表征微观组织、物相、粗糙度和硬度。
评估盐水腐蚀行为、润湿性和固体颗粒冲蚀性能。
infographic.evidence_signal: NiCrAlY的硬度达到7895.36 MPa，而80Ni20Cr为780.11 MPa；两者的腐蚀速率分别为0.00567和0.01427 mm/年；80Ni20Cr的冲蚀质量损失最低。
infographic.watch_item: 室温腐蚀试验和单一冲蚀工况（90°冲击角度、40 m/s、5 min）不能确定长期服役寿命，也不能确定不同运行工况下的性能。

title: Development of Oxide Dispersion Strengthened Bondcoats by High-Velocity Air Fuel Spraying
authors: Clément Cubertafon, Mohit Gupta, Stefan Björklund, Jonathan Gutleber, Shrikant Vishwanath Joshi
abstract: Abstract The present study explores the employment of high-velocity air fuel (HVAF) technology to produce oxide dispersion strengthened (ODS) bondcoats for thermal barrier coating (TBC) applications. In earlier works, HVAF spraying has been demonstrated to produce high-performance bondcoats with enhanced TBC lifetime and reduced thermally grown oxide (TGO) growth, making it an interesting candidate to produce ODS bondcoats. Nine coatings were deposited utilizing two commercially available MCrAlY powders, NiCoCrAlYHfSi (Amdry 386) and NiCrAlMoTaYCSi (Metco 2253A), with different alumina powder additions. The alumina powder addition in the sprayed feedstock was performed via twin-feeding and mechanical blending approaches. All samples consisted of identical topcoats deposited by suspension plasma spraying (SPS). The microstructure and performance were assessed via scanning electron microscopy (SEM), isothermal oxidation, and thermal cycling fatigue (TCF) testing. The results show the successful incorporation of the alumina particles in the bondcoat, found to be preferentially embedded at splat boundaries. Strong positive correlations between the lifetime of the TBC and alumina content were observed. Higher concentrations of added alumina fostered the early growth of a dense and homogeneous alumina scale and hindered the growth of detrimental mixed oxides within the TGO layer, encouraging a more stable and protective scale formation. Although blended powder spraying resulted in a more homogeneous alumina distribution, the overall incorporation efficiency of added alumina remained limited. The oxide incorporation mechanisms in the bondcoats occurring during HVAF spraying have been discussed. The findings underscore the potential of HVAF for the fabrication of functional ODS bondcoats with enhanced durability.

infographic.engineering_relevance: Oxide dispersion strengthened bondcoats offer a route to more durable thermal barrier coatings by promoting a dense alumina scale and limiting detrimental mixed oxides.

infographic.watch_item: Alumina incorporation efficiency remained limited, even though mechanical blending improved its distribution.

zh-Hans.title: 采用高速空气燃料喷涂制备氧化物弥散强化黏结层
zh-Hans.abstract: 摘要 本研究探索了采用高速空气燃料（HVAF）技术制备用于热障涂层（TBC）的氧化物弥散强化（ODS）黏结层。先前的研究已证明，HVAF喷涂能够制备高性能黏结层，延长TBC寿命并减缓热生长氧化物（TGO）的生长，因此该技术有望用于制备ODS黏结层。本研究采用两种市售MCrAlY粉末，即NiCoCrAlYHfSi（Amdry 386）和NiCrAlMoTaYCSi（Metco 2253A），在不同氧化铝粉末添加量下沉积了九种涂层。通过双路送粉和机械混合两种方式向喷涂原料中添加氧化铝粉末。所有样品均具有采用悬浮液等离子喷涂（SPS）沉积的相同面层。通过扫描电子显微镜（SEM）、等温氧化和热循环疲劳（TCF）试验评估其微观组织与性能。结果表明，氧化铝颗粒成功引入黏结层，并优先嵌入扁平粒子边界处。观察到TBC寿命与氧化铝含量之间存在较强的正相关性。较高的氧化铝添加量促进了致密、均匀氧化铝膜的早期生长，并抑制了TGO层内有害混合氧化物的生长，从而促进形成更稳定且更具保护性的氧化膜。尽管混合粉末喷涂使氧化铝分布更加均匀，但所添加氧化铝的总体引入效率仍然有限。文中讨论了HVAF喷涂过程中氧化物进入黏结层的机制。研究结果凸显了HVAF在制备耐久性更高的功能性ODS黏结层方面的潜力。

title: Welding Two Fields: Covalent Assembly of Polyoxometalates and Covalent Organic Frameworks for Multifunctional Applications
authors: Banhao Ruan, Shenzhen Chang, Yanhong Chen, Junwei Zhao, Qinhe Pan
abstract: Imagine a city whose architects are molecules. Polyoxometalates (POMs) are metal-oxide nanoclusters defined by precise structures and rich redox chemistry; covalent organic frameworks (COFs), by contrast, are crystalline porous polymers with highly tunable architectures. The two inhabit distinctly separate worlds, and each is already formidable in its own right. Yet once they are covalently “welded” together, they unleash a transformative power far greater than the sum of their parts. This cover story is about precisely such a union: through covalent assembly, the POMs are firmly anchored onto the ordered pore framework of the COF, endowing the hybrid material with the best of both fields—high crystallinity coupled with abundant porosity, exceptional stability, and dense yet precisely positioned active sites. This “marriage” lights up four scenes of the city on the cover: (i) catalysis—the hybrid material becomes an efficient, recyclable catalyst; (ii) chemical sensing—delivering highly selective responses toward target molecules; (iii) adsorption and separation—the porous framework captures and separates gases; and (iv) energy storage—current courses along the glowing highways as the material stores energy in batteries and supercapacitors, powering the electric vehicle parked at the charging station. Much like the smart city on the cover, where technology and ecology are inextricably woven together, these covalently “welded” POM-COF materials use molecular design as a bridge leading toward a sustainable future.

infographic.key_insight: Covalently linking polyoxometalates (POMs) to covalent organic frameworks (COFs) combines redox-active nanoclusters with ordered porous architectures for multifunctional materials.
infographic.engineering_relevance: POM–COF hybrids offer a molecular-design platform for recyclable catalysts, selective sensors, gas separation media, and energy-storage electrodes.

Combine COF porosity and crystallinity with precisely positioned POM active sites.
Target catalysis, chemical sensing, adsorption and separation, and energy storage.

zh-Hans.title: 焊接两大领域：面向多功能应用的多金属氧酸盐与共价有机框架的共价组装
zh-Hans.abstract: 想象一座由分子担任建筑师的城市。多金属氧酸盐（POMs）是具有精确结构和丰富氧化还原化学性质的金属氧化物纳米簇；相比之下，共价有机框架（COFs）则是结构高度可调的晶态多孔聚合物。二者分属截然不同的领域，且各自已具备强大优势。然而，一旦通过共价键“焊接”在一起，它们便会释放出远超各部分简单相加的变革性力量。本封面故事讲述的正是这样的结合：通过共价组装，POMs 被牢固地锚定在 COF 的有序孔道框架上，使杂化材料兼具两大领域的优势——高结晶性、丰富的孔隙、出色的稳定性，以及密集且定位精确的活性位点。这场“联姻”点亮了封面城市中的四个场景：(i) 催化——杂化材料成为高效、可回收利用的催化剂；(ii) 化学传感——对目标分子产生高选择性响应；(iii) 吸附与分离——多孔框架捕获并分离气体；以及 (iv) 储能——当材料在电池和超级电容器中储存能量时，电流沿着发光的道路流动，为停靠在充电站的电动汽车供能。正如封面上的智慧城市中技术与生态密不可分地交织在一起，这些通过共价键“焊接”的 POM-COF 材料以分子设计为桥梁，通向可持续的未来。

infographic.key_insight: 将多金属氧酸盐（POMs）与共价有机框架（COFs）通过共价键连接，可将具有氧化还原活性的纳米簇与有序多孔结构相结合，构筑多功能材料。
infographic.engineering_relevance: POM–COF 杂化材料为可回收利用的催化剂、选择性传感器、气体分离介质和储能电极提供了分子设计平台。
method: 将 POM 纳米簇通过共价键锚定在有序的 COF 孔道框架上。
将 COF 的孔隙特性和结晶性与精确定位的 POM 活性位点相结合。
面向催化、化学传感、吸附与分离以及储能应用。
infographic.evidence_signal: 摘要定性描述了结构优势和应用潜力，但未报告定量性能数据或对比评估。

title: Automatic extraction of welding trajectories for V-groove welds based on 3-D active vision imaging
authors: Jingjing Lou, Yuanhan Li, Liangliang Sun, Chuan Ye, Yuancheng Zhu
abstract: Abstract To automatically extract welding trajectories for planar welds on reflective materials, this paper proposes a three-dimensional active vision-based welding trajectory extraction methodology that is based on the fusion of features. First, to accurately segment the laser stripes at the weld seam, a saliency feature fusion-based laser stripe segmentation model (SFF_LSM) has been developed. The SFF_LSM model effectively suppresses background interference features, accurately segmenting the general features of the laser stripe distribution along the weld seam. Next, the gray-gravity algorithm with secondary smoothing is employed to extract the center of the laser stripe. Finally, the point cloud data at the weld seam is filtered, and the least squares fitting algorithm is employed to extract the welding trajectory automatically. The results of the experiment demonstrate that the proposed method is an effective means of overcoming the interference caused by reflections, with the maximum fitting errors of the weld seam welding trajectory being 0.51 mm in the X direction, 0.40 mm in the Y direction, and 0.29 mm in the Z direction.

infographic.key_insight: Feature-fused 3-D active vision automatically extracts planar V-groove welding trajectories on reflective materials while suppressing reflection interference.
infographic.engineering_relevance: The approach supports automated weld-path generation where reflective surfaces complicate optical seam detection.
method: Segment laser stripes using a saliency feature fusion model (SFF_LSM).
Extract stripe centers using a gray-gravity algorithm with secondary smoothing.
Filter seam point clouds and fit the welding trajectory using least squares.
infographic.evidence_signal: Experiments reported maximum trajectory-fitting errors of 0.51 mm in X, 0.40 mm in Y, and 0.29 mm in Z.
infographic.watch_item: The abstract does not establish robustness across different materials, groove geometries, or production lighting conditions.

zh-Hans.title: 基于三维主动视觉成像的V形坡口焊缝焊接轨迹自动提取
zh-Hans.abstract: 摘要 为自动提取反光材料上平面焊缝的焊接轨迹，本文提出了一种基于特征融合的三维主动视觉焊接轨迹提取方法。首先，为准确分割焊缝处的激光条纹，开发了一种基于显著性特征融合的激光条纹分割模型（SFF_LSM）。SFF_LSM模型能够有效抑制背景干扰特征，准确分割沿焊缝分布的激光条纹的整体特征。随后，采用结合二次平滑的灰度重心算法提取激光条纹中心。最后，对焊缝处的点云数据进行滤波，并采用最小二乘拟合算法自动提取焊接轨迹。实验结果表明，所提方法能够有效克服反光造成的干扰，焊缝焊接轨迹在X方向、Y方向和Z方向的最大拟合误差分别为0.51 mm、0.40 mm和0.29 mm。

infographic.key_insight: 融合特征的三维主动视觉能够自动提取反光材料上平面V形坡口的焊接轨迹，同时抑制反光干扰。
infographic.engineering_relevance: 该方法支持在反光表面使光学焊缝检测变得困难的情况下自动生成焊接路径。
method: 使用显著性特征融合模型（SFF_LSM）分割激光条纹。
使用结合二次平滑的灰度重心算法提取条纹中心。
对焊缝点云进行滤波，并使用最小二乘法拟合焊接轨迹。
infographic.evidence_signal: 实验报告的轨迹最大拟合误差在X、Y和Z方向分别为0.51 mm、0.40 mm和0.29 mm。
infographic.watch_item: 摘要尚未证实该方法在不同材料、坡口几何形状或生产照明条件下的鲁棒性。

title: Microstructure, Wear and Corrosion Resistances of Atmospheric Plasma, Detonation, High Velocity Oxy-fuel and High Velocity Air-fuel Sprayed WC-10Co-4Cr Cemented Carbide Coatings
authors: Ting XIA, Yueming WANG, Lu XIE
abstract: WC-10Co-4Cr cemented carbide coating has the advantages of superior wear property and corrosion resistance. WC-10Co-4Cr coatings were prepared on 304 stainless steel substrates by different thermal spray technologies including atmospheric plasma spraying (APS), detonation spraying (DS), high velocity oxy-fuel spraying (HVOFS), and high velocity air-fuel spraying (HVAFS), respectively. The microstructure, tribological properties and corrosion resistances of WC-10Co-4Cr coatings were systematically investigated and compared. The results showed that the Vickers hardness of cemented coatings prepared by APS, DS, HVOF, and HVAF, which were all higher than those of 304 stainless steel, were 771.4 HV, 954.2 HV, 1166.2 HV, and 1162.2 HV, respectively. The volume wear rate of 304 stainless steel was about (36.82±0.80)×10-5 mm3/N·m. The volume wear rates of APS, DS, HVOF, and HVAF coatings, which were all lower than that of 304 stainless steel, were about (7.93±0.30)×10-5, (1.51±0.20)×10-5, (1.17±0.10)×10-5, and (1.10±0.01)×10-5 mm3/N·m, respectively. In addition, the average friction coefficients of 304 stainless steel substrate, APS coating, DS one, HVOF one and HVAF one were about (0.68±0.03), (0.56±0.02), (0.48±0.01), (0.44±0.01) and (0.43±0.01), respectively. Spalling, microcracks perpendicular to the friction direction, and grooves parallel to the friction direction can be found in the wear marks of WC-10Co-4Cr coatings. Abrasive wear and fatigue wear are the main wear mechanisms of the cemented coatings. During the wear test, the carbide particles in DS, HVOF and HVAF coatings gradually became the main body bearing the friction load. Then the wear resistance of the latter three coatings was all superior to that of APS. Moreover, HVOF and HVAF coatings have better wear performances. For corrosion resistance from high to low were HVAF coating, DS one, HVOF one and APS one, respectively. The HVAF coating demonstrated the highest corrosion potential (-0.37±0.01 VSCE), smallest corrosion current density (1.75±0.02 μA/cm²), and largest corrosion resistance (20438.5 Ω) here. The APS coating had the poorest corrosion resistance among these four coatings.

infographic.key_insight: HVAF-sprayed WC-10Co-4Cr combined the lowest measured wear rate with the best corrosion resistance, while HVOF achieved the highest hardness.
infographic.engineering_relevance: HVAF is a promising coating route for 304 stainless steel components requiring both wear and corrosion protection.
method: Deposited WC-10Co-4Cr on 304 stainless steel using APS, detonation spray, HVOF and HVAF.
Compared microstructure, Vickers hardness, friction, wear and corrosion behavior.
Examined wear marks to identify abrasive and fatigue wear mechanisms.
infographic.evidence_signal: HVAF reduced volume wear rate from (36.82±0.80)×10^-5 for bare steel to (1.10±0.01)×10^-5 mm³/(N·m), and achieved the lowest coating corrosion current density, (1.75±0.02) µA/cm².
infographic.watch_item: The abstract does not specify wear-test conditions or corrosion medium, so performance under intended service conditions requires validation.
infographic.paper_title: Microstructure, Wear and Corrosion Resistances of Atmospheric Plasma, Detonation, High Velocity Oxy-fuel and High Velocity Air-fuel Sprayed WC-10Co-4Cr Cemented Carbide Coatings

zh-Hans.title: 大气等离子喷涂、爆炸喷涂、超音速火焰喷涂和超音速空气燃料喷涂WC-10Co-4Cr硬质合金涂层的微观组织、耐磨性和耐蚀性
zh-Hans.abstract: WC-10Co-4Cr硬质合金涂层具有优异的耐磨性和耐蚀性。采用大气等离子喷涂（APS）、爆炸喷涂（DS）、超音速火焰喷涂（HVOFS）和超音速空气燃料喷涂（HVAFS）等不同热喷涂技术，分别在304不锈钢基体上制备了WC-10Co-4Cr涂层。系统研究并比较了WC-10Co-4Cr涂层的微观组织、摩擦学性能和耐蚀性。结果表明，采用APS、DS、HVOF和HVAF制备的硬质合金涂层的维氏硬度分别为771.4 HV、954.2 HV、1166.2 HV和1162.2 HV，均高于304不锈钢。304不锈钢的体积磨损率约为(36.82±0.80)×10^-5 mm³/(N·m)。APS、DS、HVOF和HVAF涂层的体积磨损率分别约为(7.93±0.30)×10^-5、(1.51±0.20)×10^-5、(1.17±0.10)×10^-5和(1.10±0.01)×10^-5 mm³/(N·m)，均低于304不锈钢。此外，304不锈钢基体、APS涂层、DS涂层、HVOF涂层和HVAF涂层的平均摩擦系数分别约为(0.68±0.03)、(0.56±0.02)、(0.48±0.01)、(0.44±0.01)和(0.43±0.01)。在WC-10Co-4Cr涂层的磨痕中可观察到剥落、垂直于摩擦方向的微裂纹以及平行于摩擦方向的沟槽。磨粒磨损和疲劳磨损是这些硬质合金涂层的主要磨损机制。在磨损试验过程中，DS、HVOF和HVAF涂层中的碳化物颗粒逐渐成为承受摩擦载荷的主体。因此，后三种涂层的耐磨性均优于APS涂层，其中HVOF和HVAF涂层的耐磨性能更佳。耐蚀性由高到低依次为HVAF涂层、DS涂层、HVOF涂层和APS涂层。在本研究中，HVAF涂层表现出最高的腐蚀电位(-0.37±0.01 VSCE)、最低的腐蚀电流密度(1.75±0.02 μA/cm²)和最大的腐蚀电阻(20438.5 Ω)。APS涂层的耐蚀性在这四种涂层中最差。

infographic.key_insight: HVAF喷涂的WC-10Co-4Cr涂层兼具最低的实测磨损率和最佳的耐蚀性，而HVOF涂层的硬度最高。
infographic.engineering_relevance: 对于同时需要耐磨和防腐保护的304不锈钢部件，HVAF是一种具有前景的涂层制备工艺。
method: 采用APS、爆炸喷涂、HVOF和HVAF在304不锈钢上沉积WC-10Co-4Cr涂层。
比较微观组织、维氏硬度、摩擦、磨损和腐蚀行为。
检查磨痕，以识别磨粒磨损和疲劳磨损机制。
infographic.evidence_signal: HVAF将体积磨损率从未涂覆不锈钢的(36.82±0.80)×10^-5 mm³/(N·m)降至(1.10±0.01)×10^-5 mm³/(N·m)，并获得了各涂层中最低的腐蚀电流密度，即(1.75±0.02) µA/cm²。

title: Microstructure and high-temperature oxidation behaviour of HVOF and plasma sprayed Ni–Cr-based ceramic coatings on SA516 boiler steel
authors: Ankur Gill, Vikas Chawla, Amit Handa, Santosh Kumar
abstract: This study investigates the microstructural and high-temperature oxidation behaviour of SA516 boiler steel coated with Ni-20Cr, Ni-20Cr+40TiC, and Ni-20Cr+40TiN using High Velocity Oxygen Fuel (HVOF) and Plasma Spray (PS) techniques. The cyclic air oxidation tests were performed for fifty cycles at 900°C in a simulated laboratory environment, and the resulting microstructural and phase changes were analyzed by means of X-ray Diffraction (XRD), Scanning Electron Microscopy with Energy Dispersive Spectroscopy (SEM/EDS), and X-ray mapping. The uncoated SA516 steel experienced intense spalling and cracking of the oxide layer, developing an unprotected phase (Fe 2 O 3 ). Among all coatings, the HVOF-sprayed Ni-20Cr+40TiC coating diminished maximum weight gain by 95.71 % compared to bare SA516 steel, indicating superior oxidation resistance. This enhanced performance of coatings is attributed to formation a dense, protective oxide layer consisting of Cr 2 O 3 , TiO 2 , NiTiO 4 , and NiO, coupled with reduced porosity and enhanced microhardness.

infographic.key_insight: HVOF-sprayed Ni–20Cr+40TiC reduced oxidation weight gain by 95.71% relative to bare SA516 boiler steel, outperforming the other tested coatings.
infographic.engineering_relevance: This coating offers a promising route to improve the high-temperature oxidation resistance of SA516 boiler steel.
method: Applied Ni–20Cr, Ni–20Cr+40TiC, and Ni–20Cr+40TiN coatings using HVOF and plasma spraying.
Performed 50 cyclic air-oxidation tests at 900°C.
Characterized microstructure and phases using XRD, SEM/EDS, and X-ray mapping.
infographic.evidence_signal: The abstract reports severe oxide spalling and cracking on bare steel, while coating protection was attributed to dense Cr₂O₃, TiO₂, NiTiO₄, and NiO scales, reduced porosity, and increased microhardness.
infographic.watch_item: Performance over 50 laboratory air-oxidation cycles does not establish long-term durability in corrosive boiler-service environments.
infographic.paper_title: Microstructure and high-temperature oxidation behaviour of HVOF and plasma sprayed Ni–Cr-based ceramic coatings on SA516 boiler steel

zh-Hans.title: SA516锅炉钢表面HVOF和等离子喷涂Ni–Cr基陶瓷涂层的微观组织与高温氧化行为
zh-Hans.abstract: 本研究采用高速氧燃料（HVOF）喷涂和等离子喷涂（PS）技术，在SA516锅炉钢表面制备Ni-20Cr、Ni-20Cr+40TiC和Ni-20Cr+40TiN涂层，并研究其微观组织与高温氧化行为。在模拟实验室环境中，于900°C下进行了50次循环空气氧化试验，并利用X射线衍射（XRD）、配备能量色散谱的扫描电子显微镜（SEM/EDS）以及X射线元素面分布分析，分析了由此产生的微观组织和物相变化。未涂覆的SA516钢氧化层发生严重剥落和开裂，并形成了无保护性的物相（Fe 2 O 3）。在所有涂层中，HVOF喷涂的Ni-20Cr+40TiC涂层使最大增重较裸露SA516钢降低了95.71%，表现出优异的抗氧化性能。涂层性能的提升归因于形成了由Cr 2 O 3、TiO 2、NiTiO 4和NiO组成的致密保护性氧化层，同时孔隙率降低、显微硬度提高。

infographic.key_insight: 与裸露SA516锅炉钢相比，HVOF喷涂的Ni–20Cr+40TiC涂层使氧化增重降低了95.71%，性能优于其他受试涂层。
infographic.engineering_relevance: 该涂层为提高SA516锅炉钢的高温抗氧化性能提供了一条有前景的途径。
method: 采用HVOF和等离子喷涂技术制备Ni–20Cr、Ni–20Cr+40TiC和Ni–20Cr+40TiN涂层。
在900°C下进行了50次循环空气氧化试验。
利用XRD、SEM/EDS和X射线元素面分布分析表征微观组织和物相。
infographic.evidence_signal: 摘要报告，裸钢表面的氧化层发生严重剥落和开裂，而涂层的保护作用归因于致密的Cr₂O₃、TiO₂、NiTiO₄和NiO氧化层、较低的孔隙率以及较高的显微硬度。

title: Molten pool dynamic behavior and arc characteristics in laser-TIG hybrid welding of Invar steel
authors: Sen WU, Fei ZHAO, Shuili GONG, Lifeng MA, Haiyan ZHAO, Wei ZHANG
abstract: Invar steel has an extremely low coefficient of thermal expansion, making it widely used in the manufacturing of molds for aerospace composite materials. Most existing studies focus on process aspects, lacking in-depth analysis of the fluid dynamics behavior of the molten pool. Therefore, numerical simulation and high-speed photography were employed to analyze the effects of different process parameters on the molten pool morphology evolution and arc characteristics during laser-TIG hybrid welding of Invar steel, which provides crucial theoretical support for the optimization of the Invar steel welding process. The results indicate that within the laser power range of 5 ~ 6 kW, the increased power leads to greater recoil pressure, which promotes a larger penetration depth and keyhole dimension, intensifies the overall molten pool flow, and makes the arc prone to being attracted by the laser and deflected at a high power. Within the welding speed range of 0.5 ~ 0.8 m/min, a higher speed reduces the heat input, leading to a decreased penetration depth and weld width, and an increased flow velocity and cooling rate of the molten pool; additionally, the arc is prone to deformation at a high speed. Within the welding current range of 150 ~ 170 A, the increased current enhances the arc force, promoting the expansion of weld width and intensifying the molten pool convection; furthermore, the arc is more stable at a high current.

infographic.key_insight: In laser-TIG hybrid welding of Invar steel, laser power, travel speed, and current differently affect weld geometry, molten-pool flow, and arc stability.
infographic.engineering_relevance: These trends can guide welding parameter selection for Invar structures used in aerospace composite molds.
method: Numerical simulation of molten-pool dynamics
High-speed photography of welding behavior
Parameter studies of laser power, welding speed, and current
infographic.evidence_signal: Across 5–6 kW, higher power increased penetration and keyhole size; across 0.5–0.8 m/min, higher speed reduced penetration and width; across 150–170 A, higher current widened the weld and stabilized the arc.
infographic.watch_item: The abstract provides parameter-specific trends but no quantitative validation errors or weld mechanical-property results, limiting broader process qualification.

zh-Hans.title: 因瓦钢激光-TIG复合焊接中的熔池动态行为与电弧特性
zh-Hans.abstract: 因瓦钢具有极低的热膨胀系数，因此广泛用于航空航天复合材料模具的制造。现有研究大多侧重于工艺方面，缺乏对熔池流体动力学行为的深入分析。因此，本研究采用数值模拟和高速摄影，分析了不同工艺参数对因瓦钢激光-TIG复合焊接过程中熔池形态演变及电弧特性的影响，为因瓦钢焊接工艺优化提供重要的理论支撑。结果表明，在5 ~ 6 kW的激光功率范围内，功率增大会产生更大的反冲压力，促使熔深和小孔尺寸增大，加剧熔池整体流动，并使电弧在高功率下易受激光吸引而发生偏转。在0.5 ~ 0.8 m/min的焊接速度范围内，速度提高会降低热输入，导致熔深和焊缝宽度减小，熔池流速和冷却速率增大；此外，电弧在高焊接速度下易发生变形。在150 ~ 170 A的焊接电流范围内，电流增大会增强电弧力，促使焊缝宽度增大并加剧熔池对流；此外，电弧在大电流下更稳定。

infographic.key_insight: 在因瓦钢激光-TIG复合焊接中，激光功率、焊接速度和电流对焊缝几何形状、熔池流动及电弧稳定性的影响各不相同。
infographic.engineering_relevance: 这些趋势可为航空航天复合材料模具所用因瓦钢结构的焊接参数选择提供指导。
method: 熔池动力学数值模拟
焊接行为高速摄影

title: Resistance butt welding of CoCrNi-based complex concentrated alloys to 316L stainless steel from microstructure and chemical intermixing to mechanical performance

title: EFFECT OF CEO2 AND LA2O3 REINFORCEMENTS ON MECHANICAL, TRIBOLOGICAL AND MICROSTRUCTURAL PROPERTIES OF WC–12CO COATING BY HIGH-VELOCITY OXYGEN FUEL DEPOSITION TECHNIQUE
authors: Satyanarayan Dubey, Shyam Birla, Tribhuwan Kishore Mishra
abstract: Decarburization during HVOF deposition reduces the workability of Tungsten Carbide-12% Cobalt (WC-12Co) coatings. This work examines how CeO2 and La2O3 reinforcements affect HVOF-sprayed WC-12Co coatings' mechanical, tribological, and microstructural characteristics. Compared to the unreinforced coating, microstructure, phase composition, bond strength, abrasive wear, coefficient of friction, and microhardness were assessed. CeO2 or La2O3 decreased porosity and finer grain structure without affecting bond strength. Coatings with 1 wt.% CeO2 and La2O3 increased microhardness by 6% and 4%, respectively, compared to the unreinforced WC-12Co coating, which had an adhesive bond strength of 73.60 ± 5 MPa. Both changed coatings improved structural stability, grain refinement, and densification. Minimum wear rate of 3.5 × 10⁻⁵ mm³/N·m was found in WC-12Co-1La2O3, whereas the lowest coefficient of friction was 0.4 in WC-12Co-1CeO2. An oxide layer from reinforcements enhanced wear resistance. SEM investigation of worn surfaces showed debris, dislodged carbide particles, SiC grains, microcracks, and grooves as the predominant wear processes.

zh-Hans.abstract: 超音速火焰喷涂（HVOF）沉积过程中的脱碳会降低碳化钨-12%钴（WC-12Co）涂层的加工性能。本研究考察了CeO2和La2O3增强相对HVOF喷涂WC-12Co涂层力学性能、摩擦学性能及微观组织特征的影响。以未增强涂层为对照，评估了微观组织、相组成、结合强度、磨粒磨损、摩擦系数和显微硬度。CeO2或La2O3降低了孔隙率并细化了晶粒，而未影响结合强度。与未增强的WC-12Co涂层相比，添加1 wt.% CeO2和La2O3的涂层显微硬度分别提高了6%和4%；未增强涂层的界面结合强度为73.60 ± 5 MPa。两种改性涂层的组织稳定性、晶粒细化程度和致密化程度均有所提升。WC-12Co-1La2O3的磨损率最低，为3.5 × 10⁻⁵ mm³/N·m，而WC-12Co-1CeO2的摩擦系数最低，为0.4。由增强相形成的氧化物层提高了耐磨性。采用扫描电子显微镜（SEM）对磨损表面进行观察发现，主要磨损过程表现为磨屑产生、碳化物颗粒脱落，以及SiC颗粒、微裂纹和沟槽的出现。

title: INVESTIGATION OF THE FORMATION OF STRUCTURE AND WEAR-RESISTANT PROPERTIES OF WC–CO–CR COATINGS PRODUCED BY HVOF AND DETONATION SPRAYING
authors: Arystanbek Kussainov, G.Zh. Zhunissova, Ermakhan Molbossynov, Нуртолеу Магазов, Rashid Kuanyshbay
abstract: The article presents a comparative analysis of WC–Co–Cr cermet coatings deposited by detonation spray (DS) and High Velocity Oxy-Fuel (HVOF) methods. The study included an analysis of the morphology of the initial powders, as well as the microstructure and phase composition of the coatings using Scanning Electron Microscopy (SEM) and Energy Dispersive Spectroscopy (EDS). The results show that the use of homogeneous, fully alloyed WC–Co–Cr powder ensures the formation of a dense, layered structure with a uniform distribution of the carbide phase within the metallic matrix. Detonation spraying produces a harder coating (average microhardness 1449 HV), whereas HVOF provides a coating with high density, uniform microstructure, and low friction coefficient (Kt = 0.143). The comparative analysis confirmed that the mechanical and tribological properties of the coatings strongly depend on the powder morphology and the spraying method. These findings allow for the determination of optimal processing conditions for WC–Co–Cr coatings, enhancing wear resistance and durability of machine parts, which is particularly relevant for operation under intensive friction and high load conditions.

title: Interpretable ensemble learning for tensile strength prediction and welding process window optimization of friction stir-welded 7N01 aluminum alloy
authors: Xiaocui Wu, Yingjie Zhao, Huijie Zhang, Qi Cheng, Limao Wei, Yuwang Liu
abstract: This study aims to achieve high-accuracy prediction of the ultimate tensile strength (UTS) of friction stir-welded A7N01P-T4 aluminum alloy joints, elucidate the effects of welding parameters on UTS, and optimize the welding process window. Rotational speed, welding speed, and shoulder plunge depth were used as input variables, with UTS as the output. Machine learning models were developed using 27 experimental samples and evaluated by leave-one-out cross-validation. Comparison of decision tree, K-nearest neighbors, and Gaussian process regression identifies decision tree as the best baseline model, with an R 2 of 0.905. An ensemble learning strategy was subsequently introduced to construct a gradient boosting decision tree, increasing R 2 to 0.966, and grid search optimization of its key hyperparameters further improves R 2 to 0.978. SHapley Additive exPlanations analysis shows that the importance of the welding parameters follows the order of welding speed, rotational speed, and shoulder plunge depth, and the identified parameter effects agree well with the experimental results and observed microstructural evolution. The optimized model predicts fully feasible ranges of all the welding parameters for a joint efficiency of at least 90%, and the shoulder plunge depth acts as a key parameter for further refining the high-strength welding process window. These results demonstrate that the proposed approach not only improves the accuracy of UTS prediction but also reveals welding parameter effects and enables optimization of the welding process window, providing a quantitative basis for selecting FSW parameters.

zh-Hans.title: 用于搅拌摩擦焊7N01铝合金抗拉强度预测与焊接工艺窗口优化的可解释集成学习
zh-Hans.abstract: 本研究旨在高精度预测搅拌摩擦焊A7N01P-T4铝合金接头的极限抗拉强度（UTS），阐明焊接参数对UTS的影响，并优化焊接工艺窗口。以转速、焊接速度和轴肩压入深度为输入变量，以UTS为输出。利用27个实验样本建立机器学习模型，并通过留一交叉验证进行评估。对决策树、K近邻和高斯过程回归进行比较，确定决策树为最佳基线模型，其R²为0.905。随后引入集成学习策略，构建梯度提升决策树，将R²提高至0.966，并通过网格搜索优化其关键超参数，进一步将R²提高至0.978。SHapley Additive exPlanations（SHAP）分析表明，焊接参数的重要性由高到低依次为焊接速度、转速和轴肩压入深度，所识别的参数影响与实验结果及观察到的微观组织演变高度一致。优化后的模型预测了接头效率至少达到90%时所有焊接参数的完整可行范围，而轴肩压入深度是进一步细化高强度焊接工艺窗口的关键参数。这些结果表明，所提出的方法不仅提高了UTS预测精度，还揭示了焊接参数的影响，并实现了焊接工艺窗口优化，为搅拌摩擦焊（FSW）参数的选择提供了定量依据。

title: Investigation of the Effect of HVOF Spray Parameters on the Quality Properties of Cr3C2-20(Ni20Cr) Coating on Ti6Al4V Substrate
authors: Hariharan Venkataraman, Vishal Uttamrao Bagade, V.M. Biju
abstract: Systematic optimization of high-velocity oxy-fuel (HVOF) spray parameters, such as spray distance, powder feed rate, and fuel gas flow rates, requires numerous experiments to determine the conditions that maximize coating quality. In this study, full factorial design (FFD), a more robust and efficient methodology than the traditional one-factor-at-a-time (OFAT) methodology, was employed to investigate the influence of HVOF spray parameters of Cr₃C₂-20(Ni20Cr) coating deposited onto a Ti6Al4V substrate. The design of experiments (DOE) approach using an FFD with 24 experimental runs was employed to evaluate all input factors at two levels. The coating response properties were measured for each experimental run. Analysis of variance (ANOVA) was used to quantify the contribution of each spray parameter to the output responses. The effect of the interaction between spray parameters, such as spray distance, powder feed rate, and fuel gas flow rates, on the coating properties for this substrate-coating combination has scarcely been reported. Hence, a Pareto chart was also utilized to analyze the interaction effects of the spray parameters on coating properties. Finally, acceptable quality attributes such as hardness, porosity, and oxides were established with the spraying parameters, namely, standoff distance, powder feed rate, hydrogen flow rate, and oxygen flow rate, respectively, at the values of 150 mm, 25 g/min, 475 NLPM, and 205 NLPM.

title: Long-term corrosion behaviors and wear behavior of Fe-based amorphous coatings in different humidity environments
authors: Shuai Cui, Haimin Zhai, Zihan Feng, Xuqiang Li, Wensheng Li, Xiangjuan Fan
abstract: Fe-based amorphous coatings (Fe-based AMCs) were successfully prepared on Q235 carbon steel by detonation spray under different spraying parameters. The corrosion and tribology behaviors of coatings were systematically tested. The droplets show disk-like morphology with the highest circularity and expansion factor, which is crucial to reduce the defects of coatings and to form fine-lamellar-structures coatings with dense microstructure. A higher incidence of porosity defects in the coating is associated with reduced long-term corrosion resistance. Moreover, the tribo-chemical reactions between Si3N4 balls and water molecules play a significant role in wear behaviors for coating in different humidity conditions. The friction coefficient and wear rate of coatings decrease as the humidity conditions increase.

infographic.key_insight: Dense, fine-lamellar Fe-based amorphous coatings improve long-term corrosion resistance, while increasing humidity reduces friction and wear.

zh-Hans.title: 铁基非晶涂层的长期腐蚀行为及其在不同湿度环境下的磨损行为
zh-Hans.abstract: 采用不同喷涂参数，通过爆炸喷涂在Q235碳钢上成功制备了铁基非晶涂层（Fe-based AMCs）。系统测试了涂层的腐蚀行为和摩擦学行为。液滴呈圆盘状形貌，具有最高的圆度和铺展因子，这对于减少涂层缺陷、形成具有致密微观组织的细层片结构涂层至关重要。涂层中孔隙缺陷的增多与长期耐腐蚀性的降低相关。此外，Si3N4球与水分子之间的摩擦化学反应对不同湿度条件下涂层的磨损行为起着重要作用。随着湿度升高，涂层的摩擦系数和磨损率降低。

infographic.key_insight: 致密的细层片结构铁基非晶涂层可提高长期耐腐蚀性，而湿度升高可降低摩擦和磨损。
infographic.engineering_relevance: 通过控制爆炸喷涂沉积过程以尽量降低孔隙率，可提高涂层对Q235钢的防护能力，而其磨损性能取决于运行环境的湿度。
method: 采用不同的爆炸喷涂参数，在Q235钢上沉积铁基非晶涂层。
评估液滴形貌、涂层微观组织和长期腐蚀行为。
在不同湿度条件下，以Si3N4球为对偶体测试摩擦和磨损。
infographic.evidence_signal: 摘要指出，较高孔隙率与较差的长期耐腐蚀性相关，并报告了摩擦系数和磨损率随湿度升高而降低的现象。
infographic.watch_item: 磨损随湿度变化的趋势涉及Si3N4与水之间的摩擦化学作用，可能不适用于其他对偶材料。

title: EFFECT OF FLAME-SPRAYING TEMPERATURE ON THE PROPERTIES OF Ni–Cr–B–Si-BASED SELF-FLUXING COATINGS
authors: Dastan Buitkenov, Manarbek Kylyshkanov, Daryn Baizhan, Nurmakhanbet Raisov, Nurkhat Bimakhan
abstract: The present study investigates the effect of flame-spraying process parameters on the microstructure and mechanical properties of Ni–Cr–B–Si-based self-fluxing coatings. Corrosion-resistant AISI 321 austenitic chromium–nickel steel was used as the substrate material. The coatings were deposited by flame spraying using a Metal Coat 6PM-II system. To vary the thermal conditions of the spraying process, the oxygen-to-acetylene (O₂/C₂H₂) ratio was adjusted to 1.0, 1.1, and 1.2. The spraying parameters were monitored using an Accuraspray 4.0 diagnostic system. The resulting coatings were characterized in terms of microstructure, porosity, microhardness, surface roughness, and adhesion strength. Increasing the O₂/C₂H₂ ratio resulted in densification of the coating structure and a decrease in porosity from 1.97 ± 0.13% to 0.90 ± 0.09%. Concurrently, the surface roughness decreased from 4.70 ± 0.09 μm to 2.99 ± 0.11 μm, while the adhesion strength increased from 22.14 ± 4.3 MPa to 35.02 ± 3.9 MPa. The highest average microhardness of 1051.7 HV was obtained at an O₂/C₂H₂ ratio of 1.1. Among the investigated spraying conditions, the coating produced at O₂/C₂H₂ = 1.2 exhibited the lowest porosity and surface roughness together with the highest adhesion strength. The results demonstrate that controlling the O₂/C₂H₂ ratio provides an effective means of tailoring the microstructural and mechanical characteristics of flame-sprayed Ni–Cr–B–Si-based self-fluxing coatings.
venue: Journal of Surface Engineering and Coating Technology

infographic.key_insight: Increasing the O₂/C₂H₂ ratio to 1.2 produced denser Ni–Cr–B–Si coatings with lower porosity and roughness and higher adhesion, while peak microhardness occurred at 1.1.
infographic.engineering_relevance: Gas-ratio control offers a practical way to tailor flame-sprayed coating quality on AISI 321 steel, with different settings favoring hardness versus adhesion and density.
method: Deposited Ni–Cr–B–Si self-fluxing coatings using a Metal Coat 6PM-II at O₂/C₂H₂ ratios of 1.0, 1.1, and 1.2.
Monitored spraying parameters with an Accuraspray 4.0 diagnostic system.

infographic.evidence_signal: Across the tested ratio range, porosity decreased from 1.97 ± 0.13% to 0.90 ± 0.09%, roughness from 4.70 ± 0.09 to 2.99 ± 0.11 μm, and adhesion increased from 22.14 ± 4.3 to 35.02 ± 3.9 MPa; peak average microhardness was 1051.7 HV at 1.1.
infographic.watch_item: The abstract does not report absolute spray temperatures or service-life testing, so gas-ratio optimization should not be treated as a validated temperature window or durability guarantee.

zh-Hans.title: 火焰喷涂温度对Ni–Cr–B–Si基自熔性涂层性能的影响
zh-Hans.abstract: 本研究考察了火焰喷涂工艺参数对Ni–Cr–B–Si基自熔性涂层微观组织和力学性能的影响。采用耐腐蚀的AISI 321奥氏体铬镍钢作为基体材料，使用Metal Coat 6PM-II系统通过火焰喷涂制备涂层。为改变喷涂过程的热条件，将氧气与乙炔的比值（O₂/C₂H₂）分别调节为1.0、1.1和1.2。使用Accuraspray 4.0诊断系统监测喷涂参数。对所得涂层的微观组织、孔隙率、显微硬度、表面粗糙度和结合强度进行了表征。随着O₂/C₂H₂比值增大，涂层组织趋于致密，孔隙率从1.97 ± 0.13%降至0.90 ± 0.09%。同时，表面粗糙度从4.70 ± 0.09 μm降至2.99 ± 0.11 μm，结合强度则从22.14 ± 4.3 MPa增至35.02 ± 3.9 MPa。在O₂/C₂H₂比值为1.1时，获得了最高的平均显微硬度，为1051.7 HV。在所研究的喷涂条件中，O₂/C₂H₂ = 1.2时制备的涂层具有最低的孔隙率和表面粗糙度，同时具有最高的结合强度。结果表明，控制O₂/C₂H₂比值是调控火焰喷涂Ni–Cr–B–Si基自熔性涂层微观组织和力学特征的有效手段。

infographic.key_insight: 将O₂/C₂H₂比值提高至1.2可获得更致密的Ni–Cr–B–Si涂层，其孔隙率和粗糙度更低、结合强度更高，而显微硬度在比值为1.1时达到峰值。
infographic.engineering_relevance: 控制气体配比为调控AISI 321钢表面火焰喷涂涂层的质量提供了实用方法，不同配比设置分别有利于提高硬度或提高结合强度与致密度。
method: 使用Metal Coat 6PM-II，在O₂/C₂H₂比值分别为1.0、1.1和1.2的条件下制备Ni–Cr–B–Si自熔性涂层。
使用Accuraspray 4.0诊断系统监测喷涂参数。
表征微观组织、孔隙率、显微硬度、表面粗糙度和结合强度。
infographic.evidence_signal: 在所测试的配比范围内，孔隙率从1.97 ± 0.13%降至0.90 ± 0.09%，粗糙度从4.70 ± 0.09 μm降至2.99 ± 0.11 μm，结合强度从22.14 ± 4.3 MPa增至35.02 ± 3.9 MPa；平均显微硬度在比值为1.1时达到峰值，为1051.7 HV。
infographic.watch_item: 摘要未报告喷涂温度的具体数值，也未报告使用寿命测试，因此不应将气体配比优化视为经过验证的温度窗口或耐久性保证。
